name: local-llm
about: Run open-weight LLMs on this workspace's GPU (llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, TabbyAPI; LM Studio for internal use only); weights download only on Run
description: Runs open-source LLMs on this machine's GPU with llama.cpp, ik_llama.cpp or Ollama, and with vLLM or TabbyAPI once an admin installs them. LM Studio is proprietary and for internal use only: it stays off unless the deployment's operator sets ploinky var LOCAL_LLM_LMSTUDIO internal-use and restarts local-llm, and an admin must then accept its Terms to install it. Admins pick a model and a runner in Settings; weights download only when Run is pressed. Its manifest declares GPU access (containerSecurity.gpu); on the host, ploinky gpu revoke --agent local-llms/local-llm takes it away and ploinky gpu grant --agent local-llms/local-llm restores it.

capabilities.summary: Serves the open-weight model an administrator runs on this workspace's GPU.
capabilities.whenToUse: Call soul_gateway/local-llms/local-llm/default for private, on-machine generation once a model is ready; it answers 503 not_ready otherwise.
